evidence.reason: The anchored explicit-job path invokes process_item(config, [job]) but returns without using its result or calling write_result, unlike the recover branch at line 1275 which emits write_result(result). The no-selector drain path likewise calls drain(config) with no result emission at this level. Because this CLI already uses write_result for machine-readable output and the current I1 contract requires JSON on stdout, these successful/no-work paths break the invocation output contract. The fix is to have main emit exactly one structured result for job processing and draining, including empty/no-work outcomes.
